scope: Five configurations; five recorded ten-seed realtime Lv7 batches.

configurations.label: Astra constrained + random
configurations.note: Nine replay-verified losses and one human-adjudicated loss.

interpretation: Fixed ten-seed development samples; versions and service timing differ across batches. No isolated causal effect is claimed.
excluded: Entire four-attempt JEV-only pilot with unsynchronized SC2 SDK IDs; unscored service preflight calls

excluded_jev_pilot.reason: New publication macro environment had unsynchronized SC2 enums (4.11.4.78285) against client 5.0.16.97563. Two KeyError 4113 crashes; all four attempts excluded as one incompatible batch, including two replay-verified losses. No game behavior was tuned in response. Existing scripts/sync_sc2_ids.py restores identical SDK Python files to the prior research environment. A new ten-seed batch uses the same published source commit and synced SDK.
